title: Hierarchical variant tagging and autosynth changelog curator
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: model teams increasingly rely on variant families (e.g. base -> quantized -> distilled) but the registry treated variants as flat siblings. This made rollouts, compatibility checks and changelog summaries noisy when multiple closely-related variants were published. Motivation: provide explicit parent/child relationships for variants and a small autosynth engine that composes human-readable changelog snippets from delta metadata (profile deltas, perf sig changes, compatibility notes). This PR adds a hierarchical variant tagging model, migration & backfill tooling, UI preview hooks, and an autosynth changelog curator that drafts release notes for curator review. Key behavioural changes: 1) variants can declare a parent_variant_id and optional relationship_type (quantized|distilled|pruned|adapter); 2) onboarding API accepts family metadata and validates lineage constraints; 3) changelog autosynth looks at profile delta fingerprints, perf watermarks, and deprecation flags to generate prioritized bullet-lines; 4) release preview shows lineage graph and delta highlights to help reviewers accept the autosynth text. Migration: includes a non-blocking backfill script that infers likely parents using checksum heuristics and affinity matches; a safe migration path is provided (migration can be run with --dry-run, and a lineage-confidence score is written to audit logs). Testing & safety: migration requires a feature flag; autosynth outputs are drafts and must be accepted before publishing. Rollout: staged rollout to curation teams, then registry-wide opt-in. Related work: ENG-1489 (variant rollouts), PM-402 (changelog UX). Checklist: - [x] API contract and schema changes - [x] DB migration + backfill script - [x] Autosynth engine core + heuristics - [x] UI preview component and docs - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] CI pipeline updated to run migration linter Notes: this description is intentionally concise; full implementation notes and operator guidance are in docs/registry/variant_lineage.md and docs/registry/changelog-curator.md

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: nice approach to explicit lineage; can we avoid nullable parent ids for now and require explicit 'unknown' relationship_type when inference is low?

Maya Chen (author): we decided to support nullable parent_variant_id to avoid blocking existing onboardings; the backfill will add confidence scores and a migration flag will allow operators to require non-null parents later.
Sofia Martínez: autosynth looks useful but I want stronger guardrails around deprecations — suggest an explicit 'suppress-autosynth' tag when publishing experimental variants.
Maya Chen: added support to the API for a suppress_autosynth boolean and updated the docs with recommended practice.
Ibrahim Khan: DB index looks good; one nit about index name length on older MySQL versions — suggest truncated naming.
release_notes: Added hierarchical variant tagging (parent/child relationships) and an autosynth changelog curator to draft release notes based on profile and perf deltas; includes migration/backfill tooling and UI preview for release review; operators can opt into lineage enforcement via feature flag; added operator documentation and tests.
notes_on_testing: Unit tests added for schema validation, autosynth scoring, and migration dry-run. Integration tests simulate small model families and verify lineage plumbing. CI runs migration linter to catch risky schema changes. Manual validation performed against staging snapshot 2025-10-28.
post_merge_actions: 1) Run backfill with --dry-run on staging and review lineage_confidence report; 2) After validation, enable backfill and monitor audit logs; 3) Notify curation team and enable UI preview flag; 4) Collect feedback and tune autosynth templates via PM-402.
operator_migration_instructions: Run scripts/migrations/backfill_variant_lineage.py --env staging --dry-run to get confidence scores; when comfortable, run without --dry-run and keep migration logs retained for 30 days; the feature flag 'variant_lineage_enforced' controls whether onboarding requires explicit parents.
author_affirmation: I have run the migration linter and unit/integration tests locally; this PR is ready for staged rollout. -- Maya Chen
